bootstrap.sampling: Python random.Random(seed).choice(sorted_source_ids), N choices in each of 10000 draws; same source multiplicity matrix for all eight models within each dataset/cohort
bootstrap.unit: physical target source; all questions, directions, conditions and positions travel together
bootstrap.cohorts: M4 full420; BEN primary282; BEN exclusion275; seed reset for each cohort
bootstrap.interval: pointwise 95% percentile, numpy quantile method=linear (type7); no multiplicity adjustment
bootstrap.invalid_denominator: save invalid draws as NaN; report valid and invalid counts; quantile uses valid draws only; no redraw or replacement
bootstrap.point_weighting: question-direction weighted; three opposite replicates averaged within each target-question/direction/position before conditional pooling

primary_ranking: A0 balanced accuracy in fixed full population; M4 slot1; BEN optical-slot1/SAR-slot2; EarthMind native named branch; descriptive descending point estimate separately by dataset
failure_scoring: abstain and parser failure incorrect for accuracy; retain all fixed denominator rows; CIFR/RSR use frozen A0-correct eligibility; neither parser failure nor abstain is counted as directed reverse answer
second_congruent: same original A0-correct question/direction/position, on frozen subset: opposite reverse mean minus second-congruent reverse event; do not condition on second-congruent correctness
position_interaction: slot2-slot1 on corresponding joint A0-correct targets; interaction (SAR slot2-slot1)-(optical slot2-slot1) on all-four joint A0-correct targets; D uses second-congruent subset
pairwise: all 28 model pairs for fixed-population A0 balanced accuracy and pooled conflict accuracy; same source draws; no strict cross-model CIFR ranking
stratification: class/gold stratified diagnostics are exploratory as specified in the retrospective control freeze; all classes/labels retained
earthmind: no generic position, single-image or text-only controls; mark unavailable
llava: original prompt only; separately recorded scientific inclusion policy; original smoke FAIL and NOT_ADMITTED unchanged; new-format compatibility excluded
bounds: fixed distractor allocation; historical exposure; parent-scene/geographic independence not established; no cross-dataset pooled score
